newsitem.title: USA: ITI says largest customer to reduce purchase orders.
newsitem.headline: ITI says largest customer to reduce purchase orders.

text.p: ITI Technologies Inc. said Friday that its single largest customer will reduce purchase orders during the first quarter of 1997 and that revenues and earning will be greatly hurt by the move.
The news sent ITI's stock down more than 60 percent, dropping $18 to $12.125 on Nasdaq, where it was the top percentage loser and one of the most actively traded issues.

ITI said it received a letter Thursday from ADT Security Systems Inc., stating that ITI is currently not in ADT's "future strategic product planning." No specific reasons were given by ADT for the change in its product strategy.

ITI, which designs and makes wireless security systems sold by a direct sales force to independent dealers in the United States and Canada, said ADT accounted for more than 43 percent of its revenues through the third quarter of 1996.

Management has long recognised that having one customer account for such a large portion of our sales represented a business risk, ITI said. Accordingly, it said, it has been working on several new products and seeking a number of other potentially large customers.
